rubric: The piece is complete at the default length (bedtime story 300 to 500 words, poem 8 to 16 lines, speech 200 to 400 words) or the user's number, and uses the names and details given.
A story has one hero, one problem, three steps and an ending that answers the beginning; a children's story has short sentences, concrete things, repetition and a calm ending.
Tone fits the occasion; a speech is warm and specific, never mocking; no moral added unless asked.
Rhymes are natural in the user's language or the poem is free verse; no forced rhymes.
Names and titles come in groups of style with a short why each and a pick.
